# 02-feature — change what a rig does

One run is one capability: a route, a dashboard page, a setting, a host script, a suite fixture or a board family, specified, built test first, and proposed as one pull request with the guide brought along. Most of this repository's history is this job; a rig gets the change with the next release (`03-release`).

Stages, in order; inputs, outputs and checks for each are in [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md):

1. [Spec](stages/01_spec/CONTEXT.md) — what changes for whom, and the test that will prove it.
2. [Implement](stages/02_implement/CONTEXT.md) — the failing test, then the change.
3. [Verify](stages/03_verify/CONTEXT.md) — the checks, the guide, the pull request.
